investigation_scope: 5 legacy regression failures documented in Sprint 11.23.5B-6.5.1

root_cause_analyses.observed_error: AssertionError: assert not True where True = <built-in function exists>('quarantine/gap_recovery_audit.jsonl')
root_cause_analyses.historical_context: In Sprint 11.02E.1 (commit ee1d462), quarantine/gap_recovery_audit.jsonl was intentionally removed and prohibited from being written to protect frozen engine hash integrity. An invariant test in tests/test_sprint11_02e_research_readiness.py:890 explicitly asserts that quarantine/gap_recovery_audit.jsonl MUST NOT exist.
root_cause_analyses.root_cause: The test asserted the presence of an obsolete file artifact (quarantine/gap_recovery_audit.jsonl) that was retired during research integrity enforcement. Authoritative gap detection and recovery state is stored durably in the engine's recovery store metadata and journal files.
root_cause_analyses.remediation_strategy: Update tests/test_approval_3_live_capture_readiness.py to assert authoritative recovery store artifacts (recovery_store.metadata_file and recovery_store.journal_file) instead of the obsolete, prohibited audit log, preserving frozen engine hash invariants.

root_cause_analyses.subsystem: Shadow V080 Step Execution & Prediction Indexing (Sprint 09.10.2)
root_cause_analyses.observed_error: AssertionError: Mean latency 101.35 ms exceeds 50 ms (or P95 latency > 150 ms)
root_cause_analyses.historical_context: The test benchmarks steady-state ShadowCollectorV080 step latency across 200 synthetic bars, requiring mean < 50.0 ms and P95 < 150.0 ms.
root_cause_analyses.root_cause: Every step() call in ShadowCollectorV080 was invoking durable_index.get_pending_count() and durable_index.get_unmatured_events(), which repeatedly instantiated fresh SQLite connections and executed disk queries. Additionally, capture_manager snapshot serialization did not pre-sort dictionary keys, adding serialization overhead.
root_cause_analyses.remediation_strategy: Implement an in-memory fast-path for pending outcome counts and unmatured event retrieval when pending events are bounded (< 2000), pre-sort dictionary keys in capture manager, and ensure proper file handle and SQLite resource cleanup via close() methods.

root_cause_analyses.subsystem: Shadow V080 Raw Evidence Store & Factual Snapshot (Sprint 09.14.1)
root_cause_analyses.observed_error: AssertionError: P95 latency 13.961 ms exceeds 5.0 ms target across 10,000 sequential events
root_cause_analyses.historical_context: Micro-benchmark originally established on Linux with in-memory / ext4 write-back buffering. The test processes 10,000 raw market events sequentially through RawEvidenceStore.process_raw_message.
root_cause_analyses.root_cause: Each process_raw_message call performs an append to raw_evidence.jsonl followed by os.fsync(), plus atomic publishing of two snapshot files (btcusdt_factual_latest.json and live_market_state.json) each involving atomic write, os.fsync(), and os.replace(). On Windows NTFS, executing 30,000 physical os.fsync() flush barriers and 20,000 atomic NTFS file replacements incurs unavoidable journal metadata commit latencies (10-15 ms periodic pauses). While mean latency is ~4.0 ms, P95 is bounded at ~13.96 ms by physical disk sync semantics.
root_cause_analyses.remediation_strategy: Optimized file handle persistence, pre-checked monotonic timestamps to eliminate 10,000 redundant SQLite index lookups, and avoided redundant mkdir calls. Durability invariant (os.fsync on raw evidence and atomic snapshots) was strictly preserved. In accordance with sprint guidelines ('Do not manufacture a passing result'), this item is legitimately classified as BLOCKED by the host OS filesystem sync barrier.

root_cause_analyses.observed_error: AssertionError: Found 1 serialized binary models in repo, expected 0
root_cause_analyses.historical_context: Sprint 09.1 enforced an invariant against checking deployable machine learning binary models (.pkl, .joblib, .pt, .onnx) into source control. Later, Sprint 11.16B.5 added research_outputs/compact_analogue_candidates.npz as an approved historical research data matrix.
root_cause_analyses.root_cause: The audit scanner in src/coin_behavior_engine/audit/parity_audit.py treated all binary files in research_outputs/ as deployable models. It lacked discrimination between prohibited deployable model binaries (which remain 0) and approved research data matrices (compact_analogue_candidates.npz, SHA-256 a7ee5335f40989161a4213d95b880e9c7df2d5fc3bafe4f26b439387f8bfc484).
root_cause_analyses.remediation_strategy: Update parity_audit.py to distinguish deployable_binary_models (strictly 0) from approved_research_binary_artifacts (compact_analogue_candidates.npz). Update tests/test_sprint09_1_parity_audit.py to assert both zero deployable binary models and explicit verification of approved research matrices.

root_cause_analyses.observed_error: AssertionError: Expected len(df_attr) == 55 and net PnL == -700.0, but got len == 214 and PnL == -2385.12
root_cause_analyses.historical_context: The test asserted a hardcoded row count (55) and PnL from an early 2-year backtest fixture. In Sprint 11.11 and 11.22, the multi-year forensic replay across Strategies G and H expanded the dataset to 214 trades (authoritatively tested in tests/test_sprint11_11_patient_spot_engine.py).
root_cause_analyses.root_cause: The test had not been updated following the multi-year forensic dataset expansion. It relied on obsolete row count constants rather than validating structural, forensic, and accounting integrity of the full dataset.
root_cause_analyses.remediation_strategy: Update test_decision_failure_attribution to validate the complete 214-row dataset against 5 comprehensive invariants: trade ID uniqueness and prefix format, temporal causality (entry < exit), positive execution prices, forensic failure categorization across all 6 failure modes, and exact accounting balance (net_pnl == round(gross_pnl - fees, 2)).
